identity.name: Datejust 41
identity.one_liner: The 41mm Datejust with the fluted white-gold bezel and the calibre 3235 — the most-cited modern Datejust, and the one that made the 41mm case the standard Datejust size.

provenance_events.description: Rolex launches the Datejust 41 in steel with the fluted white-gold bezel and the calibre 3235 (70-hour reserve). The 41mm Datejust replaces the 41mm Datejust II (2012-2015) and the 36mm Datejust as the modern flagship. The 126334 is the most-cited modern Datejust on the secondary market.

narrative.story: The 126334 replaced the 116334 in 2016. The change was the case size (41mm instead of 36/40) and the movement (calibre 3235 with 70-hour reserve). The fluted bezel in 18k white gold is the Datejust signature; the smooth and engine-turned are also available. The 126334 is the most-cited Datejust on the secondary market because it sits in the price band where most buyers land, and the fluted bezel catches light in a way the smooth bezel does not.
